intro: Jalari Panduga is the latest Christian Telugu Christmas song written by Dr. R. Santhi Jyothi Kumar, tuned by Monica Jason, sung by Samuel Karmoji, Susmitha Karmoji, Ankit Reddi, Sreshta Reddi Karmoji, Samuel Deep, Joel Suhas Karmoji and music composed by Prasanth Penumaka. This song was released on December 21, 2025 through Samuel Karmoji YouTube channel.
